user.title: Pasture location
user.description: Experimental weather/model diagnostics. No horse-grazing safety decision. Defaults come from Home Assistant.

weather.title: Weather provider & forecasts
weather.description: Choose your weather integration. Current weather estimates and hourly forecasts can both supply estimated inputs. You can skip the provider when using your own sensors. Forecast collection begins now and cannot recover yesterday's predictions. Methods are shown on the paddock's WSC method and Moisture method diagnostics.

paddocks.title: Reserve paddock identities
paddocks.description: Choose an approximate cut or grazing date within the past year. It initially applies to all paddocks; each date can be changed later. Enable historical backfill in weather settings to retrieve weather before installation.

source.title: Weather or station source
source.description: Map a measured sensor or a weather attribute. Choose instantaneous for temperature, sunlight irradiance, humidity, cloud or wind. Choose counter/daily reset for rain or accumulated solar energy. A weather observation must represent verified observations; otherwise use weather proxy. Existing records are preserved.

data.offset: Calibration offset in normalized units (instantaneous sources only)
data.semantics: Measurement/calibration notes; attest observed weather only if verified
data.unit_override: Explicit unit mapping (blank uses entity unit)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure location
reconfigure.description: Prior timezone/location summaries remain archived under their original context. New boundaries are calculated separately.

measured_inputs.title: Inputs & fallbacks
measured_inputs.description: Choose any measured sensors first, then your weather provider and fallbacks below. Physical sensors are optional. Sunlight expects irradiance (W/m²); match rain counter type to your gauge. Weather estimates and forecasts remain labelled estimated. Cloud-based sunlight is approximate; leave clear-sky fallback off unless you want missing cloud data treated as clear. Recorded history can fill retained past inputs. Default timing and coverage are ready to use; advanced settings are optional. An ordinary soil moisture reading is shown for reference only: its percentage is not the moisture index used by the WSC model. Estimated soil moisture instead uses rainfall, weather and your paddock's soil type.

data.historical_backfill: Fill gaps using recorded weather history
data.assume_clear_sky: Assume clear skies when cloud data is missing

soil_details.title: Optional soil sensor details
soil_details.description: This setting applies only to the soil sensor you selected. One-hour freshness is a starting default: increase it if the sensor normally reports less often. This sensor is diagnostic; compatible model indices are configured per paddock.

policies.title: Data gaps & fallbacks
policies.description: Use saved Home Assistant history where available. Without a sunlight sensor, cloud-based sunlight is an approximation. Assuming clear sky when cloud data is missing can overestimate sunlight; leave it off unless you want that fallback. Missing moisture weather holds the previous level and is reported under Data gaps. Advanced settings contain calculation time and coverage thresholds; the defaults are practical settings, not accuracy guarantees.

data.assume_clear_sky: Assume clear sky if cloud data is missing

advanced_policies.title: Advanced data settings
advanced_policies.description: 00:15 calculates the previous day in your configured time zone; pending data is retried. Weather coverage 0.8 requires 80% of a day's temperature, humidity, cloud, rain and wind intervals. Solar coverage 1.0 requires complete daily coverage. These are operational thresholds, not validated accuracy limits. Lower thresholds do not reconstruct missing sunlight or rain. Live rain totals instead expose their actual coverage.

backfill.title: Backfill weather
backfill.description:
Read the configured weather entities and sensors from Home Assistant's local recorder for 1–366 completed days. No external requests are made. Only retained history can be recovered. Enable the solar estimate in weather settings to use recorded cloud cover when radiation was not measured. This also enables automatic local backfill for later gaps.

add_paddock.title: Add paddock
add_paddock.description: Choose the last cut date within the past year to start the regrowth calculation. Save configuration afterward to load its entities. Enable historical backfill in weather settings to retrieve earlier weather.

paddock_settings.title: Paddock settings
paddock_settings.description: Settings apply immediately. WSC cutoffs define descriptive levels, not animal-specific safety limits. Save configuration afterward to reload source subscriptions. Generic soil moisture remains diagnostic. A calibrated index requires compatible dimensionless wi. The estimated inputs model can use measured weather, estimates and forecasts. Moisture prefers a compatible measured index, then a rainfall/drying FAO-56 estimate using soil type, rooting depth and pasture Kc. Check wind height against your provider. Defaults and missing wind/humidity are assumptions reported by the moisture sensor. An internal starting moisture level seeds the estimate; missing weather holds the previous level. The estimate is not sensor moisture percent.
